areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Programme focuses on reducing exposure to extreme climate events through risk-prevention tools and flood-protection and drainage investments.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Specific drainage and flood-protection works product: pumping stations, conduits, gates and dikes.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Urban logistics improvement and economic development of a logistics district via infrastructure and a mobility and logistics lab and observatory.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Rebuilding and refurbishing public social facilities affected by the floods, serving vulnerable communities.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Social housing for the vulnerable population affected by the floods, through new units or acquisition.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Mobility and logistics observatory and lab bring management innovation and digitalization; a flood-monitoring and alert system also presented.
